scripts.test: npm test --workspace renderer && npm run test:native
scripts.fmt: npm run fmt:renderer && npm run fmt:rust
scripts.fmt:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && cargo fmt --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.fmt:check: oxfmt --check "renderer/{src,test}/**/*.{ts,tsx}" renderer/vite.config.tsx && cargo fmt --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.lint:rust: cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.check:pre-commit: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run check:architecture
scripts.check: npm run check:pre-commit && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:architecture: depcruise --config scripts/architecture/renderer.mjs renderer/src && node --test scripts/architecture/*.test.mjs && cargo test --locked --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml --test architecture
scripts.tauri:frontend:dev: node scripts/build-native-cli.mjs debug && npm run dev -w renderer -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.tauri:frontend:build: node scripts/build-native-cli.mjs release && npm run renderer:build
